title: fix(metadata-protocol): removing a field that stores nothing is not a destructive change
body:
Fixes #24411

Clause-②: yes (widening) (the save door newly accepts, without `force`, a removal it refused; owes the seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` review of record before the queue)

Dispatched by the `domain:engine` seat 1 PM (session `session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy`, claim comment 6259474942). Dev session: `session_01RaFonyZMJU1FzgAT78bA47`.

## What changed

`detectDestructiveObjectChanges` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (the object save's Phase 3a-destructive diff) now reports a finding only when the field holds stored data. "Stored" is the spec's storage predicate `isVirtualSearchField` (`SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES`, exactly `formula` today), read from the field's own declaration. It is the predicate the served sortability projection (`packages/spec/src/api/sortability.zod.ts`) already reads, and `protocol.ts` already imported it. No name list or type list is kept in the detector.

- `field_removed`: skipped when the removed field is unstored.
- `field_type_change`: judged by what the stored side loses. An unstored previous field (a formula) held no values, so retyping it into any kind is not destructive. Retyping a stored field into a formula is still refused, because the stored side loses its column.
- `field_required_no_default`: unchanged. It is not a storage-loss finding (see Acceptance notes).
- No change to the `force` mechanism, to the message of a true removal, or to any error code.

## Measured (M, booted composition)

Booted with `bootStack` (`@objectstack/verify`, sqlite-wasm) on a fixture app. Object `dfu_invoice` was saved at runtime through `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/dfu_invoice` with `name`/`notes` (text), `amount` (number), `doubled` (formula) and `reference` (autonumber), plus one record. Pin: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/meta-object-unstored-field-removal.dogfood.test.ts`.

| case | before (`main` `fa26308bb0`) | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| remove `doubled` (formula), no `force` | `409 DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE`, "Field 'doubled' removed — existing data in this column will become inaccessible. — re-submit with ?force=true to proceed." | `200`. `GET /data/dfu_invoice/:id` reads back `name: 'INV-1'`, `notes: 'keep me'`, `amount: 21`, `reference: '0001'` unchanged |
| remove `notes` (stored text), no `force` | `409 DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE`, issues `[{code: 'field_removed', field: 'notes', message: "Field 'notes' removed — existing data in this column will become inaccessible."}]` | identical `409`, same issue and message |
| remove `reference` (autonumber: engine-computed but stored) | `409 DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` | `409 DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` (unchanged) |

The predicate names only one unstored kind (`formula`). `summary` and `autonumber` are stored columns: the sortability docblock records them as "deliberately NOT members". So the "one more kind" reading is `autonumber`, measured as a stored control that still answers 409. This confirms the axis is storage, not `COMPUTED_VALUE_TYPES`.

Unit pins (`protocol.destructive-gate-reachable-types.test.ts` §4, reusing that file's existing engine double, so no new fake engine):

- stored-text removal control: exact issue list, nothing written;
- formula removal resolves and persists;
- autonumber removal refused;
- formula + text removed together reports `notes` alone;
- formula → number resolves;
- text → formula refused with `field_type_change`.

Before the fix, the three unstored cases were red and the stored controls green (`Tests 3 failed | 13 passed (16)`).

### Ablation (one-shot, not kept)

- **Mutation:** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` removed the line `if (!isStored(prevFields[fname])) continue;` (anchor x1 → x0, blob `767873d0` → `fb38f325`).
- **Rebuild and preflight:** `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` reported the marker absent from all 24 built files.
- **Result, red:** unit `2 failed | 14 passed` (formula removal, formula+text). Dogfood `1 failed | 2 passed`: the formula removal answered the old 409.
- **Restore:** blob back to `767873d0`, equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` empty. After a rebuild, the preflight reported the marker present in 2 built files and the tree clean. Unit 16/16 and dogfood 3/3 green.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`: exit 0. `--listFiles` includes the edited test file.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0. `--listFiles` includes the new pin.
- Gates, first pass: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derived 71 commands on `fb06fda4c`. All 71 were run, each exit captured before any pipe:
  - 70 exited 0.
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: 8 unbuilt packages). Those were built, and the re-run exited 0 ("111 published require entry point(s) across 69 package(s) load").
  - `--ran` reconciliation, with codes recorded: "71 derived, 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN … a DERIVED zero".
- The changeset-only follow-up commit re-ran `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:issue-citations` and `check:doc-authoring`: all exit 0.
- `origin/main` (`ec951e29e`) was merged cleanly before this PR opened. On the merge head `3174dbc00`, every step exited 0:
  - `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`;
  - `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`;
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`;
  - both packages' typechecks;
  - both pins.

## Pin sweep

`git grep` for `field_removed`, `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` and "will become inaccessible" across tests, docs, ADRs and the checklist found no pin that asserts a formula or unstored field removal is destructive. Every existing `field_removed` pin removes a `text` field, and those still hold. No hand-written doc states the old behaviour. ADR-0027's table names `field_removed` generically and still holds.

## Acceptance notes

- `field_required_no_default` on a formula is left as is. Its claim is about write validation of rows, not stored data becoming unreachable, and nothing here measured whether required-validation reaches a formula. That is outside this card.
- The column planner (`driver-sql` `fieldHasColumn`, `driver-turso`) still spells `type === 'formula'` locally instead of calling the spec predicate. It agrees with the predicate today. This is noted as observed drift risk only, not filed (no carrier).
- The claim's pin "a type change between two unstored kinds is not destructive" cannot be built today, because the predicate names one unstored kind. It is pinned as formula → stored (not destructive) and stored → formula (destructive). Once the predicate gains a second kind, the same `isStored(prevField)` check covers it with no edit.
